meta.title: What if you were born as Kim Kardashian? (6-minute documentary)

voice.style: documentary narrator, steady and clear, slightly brisk

sentences.text: What if you were born as Kim Kardashian?
How would your life unfold?
A famous family. Television cameras. Fashion, fame, and a business empire.
But none of that exists yet. Your story begins in Los Angeles.
You are born in Los Angeles on October 21st, 1980.
Your world is the Los Angeles of 1980: palm trees, film studios, and a city built on fame.
Your father, Robert, is a lawyer. Your mother, Kris, is raising a growing family.
You grow up beside your older sister, Kourtney. Later come a sister, Khloé, and a brother, Rob.
When you are nine, your parents separate.
It is 1989, and the home you know is about to change.
Two years later, your mother marries Olympic champion Bruce Jenner.
She marries him in April 1991, one month after her divorce is final.
Their marriage will last until 2014.
On July 30th, 1976, in Montreal, Bruce won the Olympic decathlon and set a world record.
The decathlon has ten events over two days, and its winner is often called the world's greatest athlete.
Now that name is part of your family, and Los Angeles is about to turn your father into a public figure.
The year is 1994, and a murder case grips the country.
O. J. Simpson, one of America's most famous athletes, is charged with two murders.
Your father, a lawyer, will join the O. J. Simpson defense team.
Robert is also Simpson's longtime friend.
Other lawyers on the team include F. Lee Bailey and Robert Shapiro, and Johnnie Cochran later leads it.
The trial begins in Los Angeles in January 1995, and the nation watches on television.
The jury deliberates for less than four hours.
On October 3rd, 1995, Simpson is found not guilty.
You are fourteen. Imagine watching the whole country argue about a trial your father is part of.
You graduate from high school in 1998.
Your first jobs are far from the spotlight: a clothing store, then styling clients.
In 2000, you marry Damon Thomas. The marriage ends in 2004.
By 2003, you are a personal stylist for the singer Brandy.
In 2006, you work with Paris Hilton, and you open a boutique, DASH, with your sisters.
Your mother, Kris, will later become your manager.
You are twenty-six years old, and your life is about to be filmed.
In 2007, cameras move in, and your family becomes a TV show.
In October 2007, Keeping Up with the Kardashians premieres on E!.
It will run for fourteen years.
The final episode airs in June 2021, after two hundred and ninety-four episodes.
Your private life becomes public entertainment.
The show does more than entertain. It turns your name into a brand.
In 2011, you marry Kris Humphries. Your first child is born in 2013.
In 2014, you marry Kanye West, and your own mobile game, Kim Kardashian: Hollywood, is released.
In 2017, you launch KKW Beauty.
But your father's world of courtrooms never leaves you.
In 2018, you help win a presidential commutation for Alice Marie Johnson, who was serving a life sentence.
In 2019, you launch SKIMS, a shapewear brand. By then, you are a mother of four.
In 2020, a documentary, The Justice Project, follows your work on criminal justice reform.
In 2021, Forbes counts you among the world's billionaires.
That December, you pass the California baby bar exam, on your fourth attempt.
SKIMS grows fast, and by 2023 it is valued at more than four billion dollars.
By 2025, your brand, SKIMS, is valued at five billion dollars.
That valuation comes with a $225 million funding round, announced in November 2025.
The round is led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives.
It is a company valuation, not yearly revenue.
The company says it is on track to pass one billion dollars in net sales in 2025.
From a birth in Los Angeles in 1980 to a global business, your story is anything but ordinary.
Fame, family, law, and business: four different worlds, all connected to one name.
Now imagine it was your life. What would you have done differently?

sources.claim: Born Oct 21, 1980, Los Angeles; Kris divorced Robert Kardashian (Britannica says 1989); Kim assistant to Paris Hilton; KUWTK premiere Oct 2007 on E!, ran to 2021; SKIMS 2019; 2018 Alice Marie Johnson commutation; 2020 The Justice Project; four children (2013, 2015, 2018, 2019)
sources.note: Britannica and other sources disagree on the divorce year (1989 vs final March 1991), so the narration says 'separate' (1989) and 'divorce is final in March 1991'
